title.zh: 给三条旧边编号并定义展开映射
title.en: Label the three old edges and define the extension

given.zh: v 恰有三条关联边，可选标签 c，使每个 i∈{0,1,2} 对应唯一一条 eᵢ。
given.en: Exactly three edges meet v, so choose labels c with a unique incident edge eᵢ for each i∈{0,1,2}.

claim.zh: 把旧边 eᵢ 接到三角形顶点 i，定义 f(x) 的旧边坐标仍为 x(e)，新边 i 的坐标为 x(eᵢ)。f 是线性映射。
claim.en: Attach old edge eᵢ to tip i. Set f(x)(old e)=x(e) and f(x)(new i)=x(eᵢ). This defines a linear map.

statement.zh: 把关联边集合与 {0,1,2} 配成双射，记 c(eᵢ)=i。
statement.en: Match the incident-edge set bijectively with {0,1,2}, writing c(eᵢ)=i.

reason.zh: 关联边恰有三条，因此每个标签既有对应边，又不会对应两条边。
reason.en: There are exactly three incident edges, so every label has exactly one corresponding edge.

statement.zh: f(x)(old e)=x(e)，f(x)(new i)=x(eᵢ)。
statement.en: f(x)(old e)=x(e), and f(x)(new i)=x(eᵢ).

reason.zh: 新边 i 连接另外两个顶点；旧边 eᵢ 选中时，复制它的坐标使对面的新边同时选中。
reason.en: New edge i joins the other two tips. Copying the coordinate of eᵢ selects that opposite edge whenever eᵢ is selected.

statement.zh: f(ax+by)(old e)=a·x(e)+b·y(e)，新边坐标同样成立。
statement.en: f(ax+by)(old e)=a·x(e)+b·y(e), with the same identity on new-edge coordinates.

reason.zh: 每个输出坐标都只读取一个输入坐标，所以加法与数乘可以逐坐标移到 f 外。
reason.en: Each output coordinate reads just one input coordinate, so addition and scalar multiplication commute with f coordinate by coordinate.

title.zh: 割质量只计算重新接入的旧边
title.en: Only reattached old edges contribute to the cut

given.zh: T 是三角形的三个顶点，L(y) 是一端在 T、一端在外的边的坐标总和。
given.en: T consists of the three triangle tips; L(y) sums coordinates of edges with exactly one endpoint in T.

claim.zh: L(y)=Σₑ∋ᵥ y(old e)。对完美匹配 M 的指示向量 1ₘ，这正是 M 使用的跨割旧边数量 k。
claim.en: L(y)=Σₑ∋ᵥ y(old e). For a perfect-matching indicator 1ₘ, this equals the number k of old matching edges crossing the cut.

statement.zh: new i 的两端都在 T 中，所以 new i∉δ(T)。
statement.en: Both endpoints of new i lie in T, so new i∉δ(T).

reason.zh: 割 δ(T) 只保留恰有一个端点属于 T 的边，三角形内部边不满足这个条件。
reason.en: The cut δ(T) contains edges with exactly one endpoint in T, which excludes internal triangle edges.

statement.zh: old e∈δ(T) ⇔ e 关联原顶点 v。
statement.en: old e∈δ(T) if and only if e was incident to v.

reason.zh: 关联 v 的旧边只有 v 端被接入 T；无自环保证另一端在 T 外。不关联 v 的旧边两端都留在外面。
reason.en: Only the endpoint v is reattached into T. Looplessness keeps the other endpoint outside; old edges not incident to v remain entirely outside.

statement.zh: L(y)=Σₑ∋ᵥ y(old e)；L(1ₘ)=Σₑ∋ᵥ 1{old e∈M}=k。
statement.en: L(y)=Σₑ∋ᵥ y(old e); L(1ₘ)=Σₑ∋ᵥ 1{old e∈M}=k.

reason.zh: 先按割中的边重写求和，再对指示向量把每个坐标读成零或一，就把线性泛函变成了边数。
reason.en: Rewrite the sum over cut edges, then read indicator coordinates as zero or one to turn the linear functional into an edge count.

title.zh: 三个顶点只允许两种局部匹配方式
title.en: The three tips allow only two local matching patterns

given.zh: M 是 H 的完美匹配，k 是它选中的跨割旧边数，t 是选中的三角形内部边数。这里讨论的是匹配指示向量。
given.en: Let M be a perfect matching of H, with k selected crossing old edges and t selected internal triangle edges. At this step we consider matching indicators.

claim.zh: 每个三角形顶点恰被覆盖一次，所以 k+2t=3；任意两条三角形边共享顶点，所以 t≤1。因此 (k,t) 只能是 (1,1) 或 (3,0)，L(1ₘ)∈{1,3}。
claim.en: Each tip is covered exactly once, so k+2t=3. Any two triangle edges share a tip, so t≤1. Hence (k,t) is either (1,1) or (3,0), and L(1ₘ)∈{1,3}.

statement.zh: 三角形三个顶点的覆盖次数之和为 3。
statement.en: The sum of matching-cover incidences at the three tips is 3.

reason.zh: 完美匹配要求每个顶点恰被一条选中边覆盖，三个顶点各贡献一次。
reason.en: A perfect matching covers each tip by exactly one selected edge, contributing one incidence per tip.

statement.zh: 跨割边各贡献 1，内部边各贡献 2，所以 k+2t=3。
statement.en: A crossing edge contributes 1 incidence and an internal edge contributes 2, so k+2t=3.

reason.zh: 这里只统计边在 T 内覆盖的端点数，外部顶点的覆盖不计入这条等式。
reason.en: Count only covered endpoints inside T; incidences at outside vertices do not enter this identity.

statement.zh: 任意两条三角形边相交，故 t∈{0,1}；代入得到 (k,t)=(3,0) 或 (1,1)。
statement.en: Any two triangle edges intersect, so t∈{0,1}; substitution gives (k,t)=(3,0) or (1,1).

reason.zh: 匹配不允许两条选中边共用顶点，因此不能选中两条内部边。这列出允许的局部模式，不保证每幅 G 都实现两种模式。
reason.en: A matching cannot select two edges sharing a tip. These are the allowed local patterns, without asserting that both occur for every G.

statement.zh: 每个匹配生成元都有 L(1ₘ)≥1；此处尚未把取值限制推广到整个凸包。
statement.en: Every matching generator satisfies L(1ₘ)≥1; the two-value restriction has not been extended to the convex hull.

reason.zh: 上一步 L(1ₘ)=k。凸组合可以产生介于一和三之间的质量，后面只继承统一下界。
reason.en: The preceding identity gives L(1ₘ)=k. Convex combinations may have intermediate masses, so only the common lower bound will pass to the whole polytope.

title.zh: 质量为一的匹配恰好来自原图
title.en: Mass-one matching generators come exactly from the old graph

given.zh: 原图匹配 N 在 v 处恰选一条 eᵢ；反过来，若 H 的匹配 M 有 L(1ₘ)=1，则它在 T 处恰选一条旧边。
given.en: An old matching N uses exactly one edge eᵢ at v. Conversely, an expanded matching M with L(1ₘ)=1 uses exactly one old edge at the triangle.

claim.zh: N 展开成 N 的全部旧边加新边 i，其指示向量等于 f(1ₙ)。质量为一的 M 去掉内部边后是 G 的完美匹配，并且 1ₘ=f(1_oldPart(M))。
claim.en: Expand N by retaining its old edges and adding new edge i; its indicator is f(1ₙ). Removing the internal edge from a mass-one M gives a perfect matching of G, and 1ₘ=f(1_oldPart(M)).

statement.zh: 若 N 在 v 处选中 eᵢ，则令 M={old e:e∈N}∪{new i}。
statement.en: If N selects eᵢ at v, set M={old e:e∈N}∪{new i}.

reason.zh: eᵢ 在展开图中覆盖顶点 i，新边 i 覆盖另两个顶点；三角形外的匹配边保持原样。
reason.en: The reattached eᵢ covers tip i and new edge i covers the other two tips, while all outside matching edges remain unchanged.

statement.zh: 1ₘ(old e)=1ₙ(e)，1ₘ(new j)=1ₙ(eⱼ)，故 1ₘ=f(1ₙ)。
statement.en: 1ₘ(old e)=1ₙ(e) and 1ₘ(new j)=1ₙ(eⱼ), hence 1ₘ=f(1ₙ).

reason.zh: 原匹配在 v 处只选 eᵢ，因此新边等式两侧都恰在 j=i 时取一。
reason.en: The old matching selects only eᵢ at v, so the new-edge coordinate formula is one exactly when j=i.

statement.zh: 若 L(1ₘ)=1，则 k=1、t=1；把 T 收缩回 v 后，oldPart(M) 在 v 处恰覆盖一次。
statement.en: If L(1ₘ)=1, then k=t=1; collapsing T back to v makes oldPart(M) cover v exactly once.

reason.zh: 唯一跨割边负责覆盖收缩后的 v；三角形外的每个顶点仍由原先那条旧边恰好覆盖一次。
reason.en: The unique crossing edge covers the collapsed v, and each outside vertex remains covered by its unique old matching edge.

statement.zh: 唯一跨割边是 old eᵢ 时，内部边只能是 new i，因此 1ₘ=f(1_oldPart(M))。
statement.en: When the unique crossing edge is old eᵢ, the internal edge must be new i, giving 1ₘ=f(1_oldPart(M)).

reason.zh: 顶点 i 已被跨割边覆盖，内部边只能连接另外两个顶点；这排除了反向还原中多选或漏选新边的可能。
reason.en: Tip i is already covered by the crossing edge, so the internal edge must join the remaining tips. This uniquely determines the new-edge coordinates in the inverse construction.

title.zh: 凸组合达到质量一时只能使用质量一的生成元
title.en: A mass-one convex combination only uses mass-one generators

given.zh: 任取 y=Σⱼwⱼsⱼ∈R，其中 sⱼ 是匹配指示向量、wⱼ≥0、Σⱼwⱼ=1，并假设 L(y)=1。
given.en: Take y=Σⱼwⱼsⱼ∈R, with matching indicators sⱼ, weights wⱼ≥0 and Σⱼwⱼ=1, and assume L(y)=1.

claim.zh: 所有正权项都满足 L(sⱼ)=1，故 Q=R∩{L=1}=conv{s∈生成元:L(s)=1}=f(P)。一般 y∈R 的割质量可取中间值，并不局限于一或三。
claim.en: Every positive-weight term satisfies L(sⱼ)=1. Hence Q=R∩{L=1}=conv{generators s:L(s)=1}=f(P). A general point of R may have an intermediate cut mass, rather than only one or three.

statement.zh: L(y)−1=ΣⱼwⱼL(sⱼ)−Σⱼwⱼ=Σⱼwⱼ(L(sⱼ)−1)。
statement.en: L(y)−1=ΣⱼwⱼL(sⱼ)−Σⱼwⱼ=Σⱼwⱼ(L(sⱼ)−1).

reason.zh: 把 y 的凸组合代入线性泛函，并使用权重和为一；差值被写成每个生成元超出下界的加权总量。
reason.en: Apply the linear functional to the convex combination and use the unit weight sum. The difference becomes the weighted total excess above the lower bound.

statement.zh: L(y)=1 时，Σⱼwⱼ(L(sⱼ)−1)=0，且每一项均非负。
statement.en: If L(y)=1, the sum Σⱼwⱼ(L(sⱼ)−1) is zero and every summand is nonnegative.

reason.zh: wⱼ≥0 来自凸组合，L(sⱼ)−1≥0 来自匹配生成元的计数下界，因此不存在正负相抵。
reason.en: The weights are nonnegative and the matching count gives L(sⱼ)−1≥0, so cancellation between positive and negative terms is impossible.

statement.zh: wⱼ>0 ⇒ L(sⱼ)=1；删去零权项后，y 仍是质量一生成元的凸组合。
statement.en: wⱼ>0 implies L(sⱼ)=1. Removing zero-weight terms leaves y as a convex combination of mass-one generators.

reason.zh: 非负有限和为零使每一项为零；正权重可以约去。删掉的项既不改变向量和，也不改变权重和。
reason.en: Every term in a zero nonnegative finite sum vanishes, and a positive weight can be cancelled. Removing zero-weight terms preserves both the vector sum and total weight.

statement.zh: Q=conv{f(1ₙ):N 是 G 的匹配}=f(conv{1ₙ})=f(P)。
statement.en: Q=conv{f(1ₙ):N is a matching of G}=f(conv{1ₙ})=f(P).

reason.zh: 用前一步的生成元双向对应替换集合，再用 f(Σwⱼxⱼ)=Σwⱼf(xⱼ) 把 f 移出凸包。
reason.en: Replace the generators using the preceding two-way correspondence, then commute f with each convex combination to move it outside the convex hull.

title.zh: 达到线性下界的截面是一个面
title.en: The section attaining the linear lower bound is a face

given.zh: R 是凸包，故为凸集；所有 y∈R 都满足 L(y)≥1，Q=R∩{L=1}。
given.en: R is a convex hull and thus convex. Every y∈R satisfies L(y)≥1, and Q=R∩{L=1}.

claim.zh: Q 为凸集，并且当 z=αx+βy∈Q、x,y∈R、α,β>0、α+β=1 时，必有 x,y∈Q。
claim.en: Q is convex. If z=αx+βy∈Q with x,y∈R, α,β>0 and α+β=1, then x,y∈Q.

statement.zh: 若 y=Σⱼwⱼsⱼ∈R，则 L(y)=ΣⱼwⱼL(sⱼ)≥Σⱼwⱼ=1。
statement.en: For y=Σⱼwⱼsⱼ∈R, L(y)=ΣⱼwⱼL(sⱼ)≥Σⱼwⱼ=1.

reason.zh: 每个生成元的下界由非负权重保留下来，这里得到的是整个 R 上的下界。
reason.en: Nonnegative weights preserve the generator bound, giving the lower bound on all of R.

statement.en: If z=αx+βy∈Q, then α(L(x)−1)+β(L(y)−1)=0.

reason.zh: 线性性给出 L(z)=αL(x)+βL(y)=1，再减去 α+β=1。两项都非负。
reason.en: Linearity gives L(z)=αL(x)+βL(y)=1; subtract α+β=1. Both resulting terms are nonnegative.

statement.zh: α,β>0 ⇒ L(x)=L(y)=1；再结合 Q=R∩{L=1} 的凸性，得到 Q 是 R 的面。
statement.en: Since α,β>0, L(x)=L(y)=1. Together with convexity of Q=R∩{L=1}, this makes Q a face of R.

reason.zh: 非负两项和为零使二者同时为零。这样内部点落在 Q 的线段，其两个端点也必须落在 Q。
reason.en: A zero sum of two nonnegative terms forces both to vanish. Thus whenever an interior point of a segment in R lies in Q, both endpoints lie in Q as well.

title.zh: 旧边限制给出展开映射的逆
title.en: Restriction to old edges inverts the extension

given.zh: g 只保留旧边坐标，f 在旧边上原样复制；同时已经知道 Q=f(P)。
given.en: The map g retains old-edge coordinates, f copies those coordinates unchanged, and Q=f(P).

claim.zh: 对所有 x 有 g(f(x))=x；对 y∈Q 有 f(g(y))=y。因而 f:P→Q 是线性同构，且对常量向量 x≡1/3 有 f(x)≡1/3。
claim.en: For every x, g(f(x))=x; for y∈Q, f(g(y))=y. Thus f:P→Q is a linear isomorphism, and a constant vector x≡1/3 is sent to f(x)≡1/3.

statement.zh: g(f(x))(e)=f(x)(old e)=x(e)，所以 g∘f=id。
statement.en: g(f(x))(e)=f(x)(old e)=x(e), so g∘f=id.

reason.zh: g 的定义就是读取旧边坐标，f 在这些坐标上没有改变输入。
reason.en: By definition g reads old-edge coordinates, and f leaves those coordinates unchanged.

statement.en: If f(x)=f(x′), then x=g(f(x))=g(f(x′))=x′.

reason.zh: 在两边应用 g，把输出相等还原成输入相等，因此 f 单射。
reason.en: Applying g to both sides recovers equality of the inputs, proving injectivity of f.

statement.zh: y∈Q=f(P) ⇒ y=f(x) ⇒ f(g(y))=f(g(f(x)))=f(x)=y。
statement.en: If y∈Q=f(P), write y=f(x); then f(g(y))=f(g(f(x)))=f(x)=y.

reason.zh: 像的等式提供 x∈P；中间的 g(f(x)) 再用第一行消去。第二个逆等式只在 Q 上使用。
reason.en: The image equality supplies x∈P, and the first identity removes g(f(x)). This second inverse identity is used only on Q.

statement.zh: 若 x(e)=1/3 对所有旧边成立，则 f(x)(old e)=f(x)(new i)=1/3。
statement.en: If x(e)=1/3 on all old edges, then f(x)(old e)=f(x)(new i)=1/3.

reason.zh: 新边 i 复制的是旧边 eᵢ 的坐标，所以常量向量在全部展开坐标上仍然保持常量。
reason.en: The new edge i copies the coordinate of eᵢ, so all expanded coordinates retain the same constant value.

title.zh: 最小面随线性同构一起传递
title.en: The linear isomorphism transports minimal faces

given.zh: x∈P，Q=f(P) 是 R 的面，g∘f=id，f∘g 在 Q 上为恒等映射；minFace 是所有经过该点的凸面的交。
given.en: Let x∈P. The image Q=f(P) is a face of R, g∘f=id, and f∘g is the identity on Q. The minimal face is the intersection of all convex faces through the point.

claim.zh: minFace(R,f(x))=f(minFace(P,x))，完成原题关于匹配多面体、逆映射、三分之一向量和最小面的全部结论。
claim.en: minFace(R,f(x))=f(minFace(P,x)), completing the stated conclusions about the polytope image, inverse maps, the one-third vector and minimal faces.

statement.zh: f(x)∈Q 且 Q 是 R 的面，因此 minFace(R,f(x))⊆Q。
statement.en: Since f(x)∈Q and Q is a face of R, minFace(R,f(x))⊆Q.

reason.zh: 最小面是所有经过该点的凸面的交；Q 正是可以参与这个交的一个面。
reason.en: The minimal face is the intersection of convex faces through the point, and Q is one of those faces.

statement.zh: 对 F⊆Q，F 是 R 的面 ⇔ F 是 Q 的面。
statement.en: For F⊆Q, F is a face of R if and only if it is a face of Q.

reason.zh: 一个方向直接限制环境；另一个方向先用 Q 的面性质把线段端点留在 Q，再用 F 的面性质。
reason.en: One direction restricts the ambient set. For the other, the face property of Q first places segment endpoints in Q, and the face property of F then applies.

statement.zh: 对 S⊆P，S 是 P 的面 ⇔ f(S) 是 Q 的面，且凸性也由 f、g 双向保持。
statement.en: For S⊆P, S is a face of P if and only if f(S) is a face of Q; f and g also preserve convexity in both directions.

reason.zh: 把开线段等式在 f、g 下传递。g∘f=id 与 Q 上 f∘g=id 确保端点和内部点都能还原。
reason.en: Transport each open-segment identity through f and g. Their inverse identities recover both endpoints and interior points, so no face condition is lost.

statement.zh: minFace(R,f(x))=minFace(Q,f(x))=f(minFace(P,x))。
statement.en: minFace(R,f(x))=minFace(Q,f(x))=f(minFace(P,x)).

reason.zh: 第一行把 R 的最小面限制在 Q 内，第二行识别两种环境下的面，第三行把所有经过指定点的面一一对应后取交。
reason.en: The first line confines the minimal face to Q, the second identifies the ambient face conditions, and the third pairs all faces through the chosen point before taking their intersection.
